# Sample Assessment Pack — generated by the agent (WORKED EXAMPLE)

**Job:** Listing & Reply Checker — TidyNest Online
**Generated from:** Job Card v1 + Knowledge Base v1 (catalog §2, pricing §3, tone guide §5, rubric §8)
**Status:** Draft → employer reviews → employer approves → only then can it be sent to the pool
**Skills & targets:** Price & Detail Accuracy **80** · Taglish Tone Judgment **75** · Prompt Judgment **70**
**Format:** 6 tasks · 2 per skill · ~15 minutes · phone-first · each skill scored out of 100 (2 tasks × 50)

---

## A. Candidate view (what the employee sees — no key, Taglish instructions)

> **Skill Check — Listing & Reply Checker**
> Kumusta! Ito ay maiikling tasks na gaya ng totoong trabaho. Walang trick questions. Basahin ang bawat isa at piliin ang pinakamagandang sagot. ~15 minuto ito. Hindi makikita ng employer ang pangalan mo habang sini-score ito.

**Task 1 (Price & Detail Accuracy).** Eto ang draft listing. Piliin ang **lahat** ng mali, base sa catalog ng TidyNest:
> "Foldable Laundry Basket | 38L | TidyNest — ₱259. Glass material. Colors: gray. Delivery Metro Manila ₱80."
> A. Ang presyo (₱259 — dapat ₱299) · B. Ang materyal ("glass") · C. Ang delivery fee (₱80 — dapat ₱50 sa Metro Manila) · D. Ang laki (38L) · E. Ang kulay (gray)

**Task 2 (Price & Detail Accuracy).** Buyer order: 2 × Storage Box 45L (₱499 each) + delivery to Quezon City + voucher WELCOME50. Magkano ang babayaran?
> A. ₱998 · B. ₱1,048 · C. ₱948 · D. ₱1,098

**Task 3 (Taglish Tone Judgment).** Nasira ang mop na dumating kay buyer. Alin ang pinakamagandang reply?
> A. "SIR YAN PO ANG PINADALA NAMIN, BAKA KAYO ANG NAKASIRA."
> B. "Kumusta po! Naku, pasensya na po sa sira. Paki-send po ng litrato ng item dito, at aayusin po namin ang kapalit o refund ayon sa inyong gusto. Salamat po sa pag-report agad."
> C. "We regret the inconvenience. Your concern has been noted and will be forwarded to the appropriate department for processing."

**Task 4 (Taglish Tone Judgment).** Alin sa mga reply ang **lumalabag** sa tone guide ng TidyNest?
> A. "Kumusta po! Na-check ko po — darating po bukas ang parcel ninyo. Salamat po sa paghihintay!"
> B. "Refund agad-agad po, i-GCash niyo lang po sa personal number ko."
> C. "Kumusta po! Ubos na po ang beige. May gray po kami — gusto niyo po ba?"

**Task 5 (Prompt Judgment).** Gusto mong ipasulat sa AI ang description ng LED Motion Sensor Light (TN-003). Alin ang pinakamalinaw na utos?
> A. "Gawan mo ng description ang ilaw."
> B. "Sumulat ng 3-sentence na description para sa LED Motion Sensor Light: warm white, USB rechargeable, ₱349. Friendly Taglish. Huwag sasabihing solar powered."
> C. "Yung maganda ha, yung mabebenta, mahaba dapat."

**Task 6 (Prompt Judgment).** Mali ang draft ng AI sa Shoe Rack (TN-006) — nagkapalit ang height at width. Alin ang pinakamagandang utos para ayusin ito?
> A. "Ayusin mo yan."
> B. "Ulitin mo, mali ka."
> C. "I-correct ang Shoe Rack 4-Tier listing: gamitin ang catalog specs na 80 × 30 × 92 cm (width × depth × height), presyo ₱799, at panatilihin ang title format na Product | Spec | TidyNest."
> D. "Palitan ang size ng Shoe Rack ng 80 × 30 × 92 cm."

## B. Employer key & rubric (employer only — never shown to candidates)

| Task | Skill | Correct | Points | Built from |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Price & Detail | **A, B, C** (D and E are correct details) | 50 — partial: 15 per error found (max 45) + 5 if no correct detail is falsely flagged | KB §2 (TN-009), §3 |
| 2 | Price & Detail | **₱998** (₱499×2 = ₱998; + ₱50 MM delivery = ₱1,048; − ₱50 voucher = ₱998) | 50 — by step: correct subtotal 20, correct delivery fee 15, voucher applied 15 | KB §3 |
| 3 | Tone | **B** (template: acknowledge → photo → replacement/refund) | 50 | KB §5 template |
| 4 | Tone | **B** (outside-platform personal GCash = hard violation) | 50 | KB §5 "Never" list |
| 5 | Prompt | **B** (names product, specs, price, length, tone, and the forbidden claim) | 50 | KB §2 (TN-003), §4 |
| 6 | Prompt | **C** (gives the correct data, the price, the format, and what to change) | 50 — by element: correct specs 20, price 10, title format 10, clear instruction 10. (Option D earns 30: specs + clarity only.) | KB §2 (TN-006), §4 |

**Scoring rules (code, not LLM):** per-skill score = sum of its 2 tasks. Blind: the scorer receives answers + candidate ID only. Sorting vs targets 80/75/70 with the standing gap-hours formula. The employer can open any attempt and see this table beside the candidate's answers (QA Explainer).

| Task | Jomar's answer | Result | Skill score |

| 2 | ₱1,048 (subtotal ✔, delivery ✔, voucher forgotten) | 20 + 15 + 0 = 35/50 | **Price = 55** |
| 3 | B | ✔ 50/50 | |
| 4 | A (missed that the GCash reply is the violation) | ✘ 0/50 | **Tone = 50** |
| 5 | B | ✔ 50/50 | |
| 6 | D (right specs, but no price, no format) | 20 + 10 = 30/50 | **Prompt = 80** |

**Sorting (automatic):** Price 55 < 80 (gap 25 → 2h) · Tone 50 < 75 (gap 25 → 2h) · Prompt 80 ≥ 70 ✔ → **TRAINABLE, ~4 hours** → module with exactly 2 sections (Price, Tone) → final test → pass at employer score 80 → **GUARANTEED offer, seat 2 of 2**.

*Every partial-credit rule used above is written in the key (Section B) before approval. The scorer applies that table and nothing else — the agent may never invent a deduction at scoring time. This is also what the QA Explainer shows the employer, item by item.*
